definition: more than is necessary or reasonable
sentence: He was {excessively} polite, apologizing for every small thing.
translation: Он был чрезмерно вежлив, извиняясь за каждую мелочь.

definition: land used for growing crops or keeping animals
sentence: The new road will cut through rich {farmland}.
translation: Новая дорога пройдёт через плодородные сельскохозяйственные земли.

definition: in a very strong, angry or determined way
sentence: The two shops compete {fiercely} for the same customers.
translation: Два магазина яростно конкурируют за одних и тех же покупателей.

definition: coming after thirteen others in order
sentence: The {fourteenth} floor is really the thirteenth in that hotel.
translation: Четырнадцатый этаж в этом отеле на самом деле тринадцатый.

definition: the study of family history and the line of ancestors
sentence: Her interest in {genealogy} led her to a cousin in Canada.
translation: Интерес к генеалогии привёл её к кузену в Канаде.

definition: in terms of where places are on the Earth
sentence: The two villages are {geographically} close but have different dialects.
translation: Две деревни географически близки, но говорят на разных диалектах.

definition: special glasses that protect the eyes from water, wind or chemicals
sentence: Wear {goggles} when you use the grinder.
translation: Надевай защитные очки, когда работаешь с шлифовальной машиной.

definition: relating to grammar, or following the rules of grammar
sentence: The essay had several {grammatical} errors in the first paragraph.
translation: В первом абзаце эссе было несколько грамматических ошибок.

definition: a soft black form of carbon used in pencils and as a lubricant
sentence: The pencil's dark line is made of {graphite}, not lead.
translation: Тёмная линия карандаша сделана из графита, а не свинца.

definition: a belief that goes against the official teaching of a religion or group
sentence: In the Middle Ages, people were burned for {heresy}.
translation: В Средние века людей сжигали за ересь.

definition: a viral disease that causes painful spots on the skin, often around the mouth
sentence: Cold sores on the lips are caused by the {herpes} virus.
translation: Простуда на губах вызывается вирусом герпеса.

definition: a young person who follows the latest fashions outside the mainstream
sentence: The cafe is full of one {hipster} after another with a laptop.
translation: Кафе полно хипстеров с ноутбуками.

definition: a woman who welcomes guests at a party, restaurant or on a plane
sentence: The {hostess} showed us to a table by the window.
translation: Хостес проводила нас к столику у окна.

definition: a very large piece of ice floating in the sea
sentence: The ship hit an {iceberg} and sank in three hours.
translation: Корабль столкнулся с айсбергом и затонул за три часа.

definition: light, or the act of lighting something up
sentence: The {illumination} of the bridge at night attracts tourists.
translation: Подсветка моста ночью привлекает туристов.

definition: to make a person or place poor
sentence: Years of war served to {impoverish} the whole region.
translation: Годы войны обнищили весь регион.

definition: in a way that is wrong, dishonest or not suitable
sentence: The report says the money was {improperly} spent on gifts.
translation: В отчёте говорится, что деньги были неправомерно потрачены на подарки.

definition: very clever and original, used of ideas, inventions or people
sentence: She found an {ingenious} way to open the lock with a hairpin.
translation: Она нашла остроумный способ открыть замок шпилькой.

definition: a long, hard series of questions, like a trial
sentence: Coming home late meant facing an {inquisition} from my parents.
translation: Прийти домой поздно означало выдержать допрос родителей.

definition: the stone or brick parts of a building, or the work of building with them
sentence: The old {masonry} of the church needs repair after the earthquake.
translation: Старая каменная кладка церкви нуждается в ремонте после землетрясения.

definition: by machine, or without thinking, like a machine
sentence: She answered the questions {mechanically}, thinking of something else.
translation: Она отвечала на вопросы механически, думая о другом.

definition: containing or covered with oil, or too polite in a way that is not sincere
sentence: His hair looked {oily} after three days without washing.
translation: После трёх дней без мытья его волосы выглядели сальными.

definition: according to what seems or is said to be true, but perhaps not
sentence: He called {ostensibly} to ask about work, but really to borrow money.
translation: Он позвонил якобы спросить о работе, а на самом деле занять денег.

definition: saying what you think openly, even if it shocks or offends people
sentence: She is an {outspoken} critic of the new tax.
translation: Она открыто критикует новый налог.

definition: the top part of the inside of the mouth, or a person's sense of taste
sentence: The hot soup burned the roof of my {palate}.
translation: Горячий суп обжёг мне нёбо.

definition: a base on which a statue or column stands
sentence: The statue was lifted onto a marble {pedestal}.
translation: Статую подняли на мраморный пьедестал.

definition: the record of an animal's parents and ancestors, or a person's background
sentence: The puppy has a {pedigree} going back ten generations.
translation: У щенка родословная, уходящая на десять поколений назад.

definition: not real or sincere; false
sentence: He gave the police a {phony} name and address.
translation: Он назвал полиции фальшивое имя и адрес.

definition: to find or say exactly where or what something is
sentence: Doctors could not {pinpoint} the cause of her headaches.
translation: Врачи не могли точно определить причину её головных болей.

definition: in an enjoyable, friendly or agreeable way
sentence: I was {pleasantly} surprised by how cheap the hotel was.
translation: Я был приятно удивлён тем, как дёшев был отель.

definition: great skill or ability at something, especially sport or fighting
sentence: His {prowess} on the football field won him a scholarship.
translation: Его мастерство на футбольном поле принесло ему стипендию.

definition: in a way that relates to the mind and how it affects behavior
sentence: The long trial was {psychologically} exhausting for the witnesses.
translation: Долгий процесс был психологически изнурительным для свидетелей.

definition: money paid back to someone for costs they have paid
sentence: Keep the receipts if you want {reimbursement} for the taxi.
translation: Сохрани чеки, если хочешь возмещения за такси.

definition: to feel sorry for something bad you did and decide not to do it again
sentence: The thief said he would {repent} and start a new life.
translation: Вор сказал, что раскается и начнёт новую жизнь.

definition: the liquid produced in the mouth that helps you swallow food
sentence: The smell of fresh bread filled my mouth with {saliva}.
translation: От запаха свежего хлеба у меня потекли слюнки.

definition: having no purpose or meaning, or unconscious
sentence: It was a {senseless} crime; nothing was even stolen.
translation: Это было бессмысленное преступление, даже ничего не украли.

definition: coming after sixteen others in order
sentence: The castle was built in the {seventeenth} century.
translation: Замок был построен в семнадцатом веке.

definition: the moment when an aircraft leaves the ground
sentence: Please fasten your seat belts for {takeoff}.
translation: Пожалуйста, пристегните ремни перед взлётом.

definition: on which tax must be paid
sentence: Interest from a savings account is {taxable} income.
translation: Проценты по сберегательному счёту — налогооблагаемый доход.

definition: an exercise machine with a moving belt that you walk or run on
sentence: I run five kilometers on the {treadmill} every morning.
translation: Я каждое утро пробегаю пять километров на беговой дорожке.

definition: impossible to prevent or avoid
sentence: Some delay is {unavoidable} when the trains are this full.
translation: Некоторая задержка неизбежна, когда поезда так переполнены.

definition: done by one side only, without agreement from the others
sentence: The company made a {unilateral} decision to cut wages.
translation: Компания в одностороннем порядке решила урезать зарплаты.

definition: a large round fruit with green skin, red flesh and black seeds
sentence: We ate cold {watermelon} on the beach after swimming.
translation: Мы ели холодный арбуз на пляже после купания.

definition: towards the west
sentence: The wagons rolled {westward} across the plains for months.
translation: Фургоны месяцами катились на запад через равнины.

definition: to shine or burn in an unsteady way, going on and off quickly
sentence: The candle began to {flicker} in the draft from the door.
translation: Свеча замерцала на сквозняке от двери.

definition: a person who behaves in a wild, dangerous or crazy way
sentence: He drives like a {maniac} on the mountain roads.
translation: Он гоняет по горным дорогам как безумец.

definition: a wall or barrier built quickly to block a street or entrance
sentence: Protesters built a {barricade} of cars and furniture across the road.
translation: Протестующие построили баррикаду из машин и мебели поперёк дороги.

definition: one of the main beliefs or principles of a religion or theory
sentence: Equality before the law is a basic {tenet} of democracy.
translation: Равенство перед законом — базовый принцип демократии.

definition: a small increase in a number or amount, often one of a regular series
sentence: Your salary rises by a fixed {increment} every year.
translation: Ваша зарплата растёт на фиксированную прибавку каждый год.

definition: a person who takes control of a country or people by force
sentence: The {conqueror} built a castle on the hill above the town.
translation: Завоеватель построил замок на холме над городом.

definition: a false idea or belief, especially one that many people think is true
sentence: It is a {fallacy} that we only use ten percent of our brain.
translation: То, что мы используем лишь десять процентов мозга, — заблуждение.

definition: to change chemically through the action of yeast or bacteria, as in making wine
sentence: Grape juice will {ferment} into wine in a few weeks.
translation: Виноградный сок за несколько недель перебродит в вино.

definition: a small worm that lives in water and sucks blood from animals and people
sentence: A {leech} attached itself to his leg in the pond.
translation: В пруду к его ноге присосалась пиявка.

definition: a person who receives a pension, usually because they are old
sentence: The {pensioner} lives alone on a small income.
translation: Пенсионер живёт один на небольшой доход.

definition: a chemical made of hydrogen and carbon, such as oil or gas
sentence: Burning any {hydrocarbon} releases carbon dioxide.
translation: Сжигание любого углеводорода выделяет углекислый газ.

definition: to let saliva run out of your mouth, or to show great desire for something
sentence: Big dogs {drool} when they see their dinner.
translation: Большие собаки пускают слюни, когда видят свой ужин.

definition: to wake someone up, or to make someone feel strong emotion
sentence: The speech helped {rouse} the tired crowd to cheer again.
translation: Речь помогла расшевелить уставшую толпу, и она снова ликовала.

definition: one of the small bones that form the spine
sentence: The accident cracked a {vertebra} in his lower back.
translation: В аварии у него треснул позвонок в пояснице.

definition: a small boat kept on a ship to save people if the ship sinks
sentence: Every passenger has a place in a {lifeboat}.
translation: У каждого пассажира есть место в спасательной шлюпке.

definition: a bean rich in protein, used to make oil, milk and tofu
sentence: Tofu is made from the {soybean}, not from milk.
translation: Тофу делают из соевых бобов, а не из молока.

definition: an official in a government department, especially one who follows rules too strictly
sentence: Some {bureaucrat} lost my form and I had to start again.
translation: Какой-то чиновник потерял мою форму, и мне пришлось начать заново.

definition: a building with large blades that the wind turns to grind grain
sentence: The old {windmill} still grinds flour on windy days.
translation: Старая ветряная мельница до сих пор мелет муку в ветреные дни.

definition: to join metal parts by melting a soft metal between them
sentence: You need to {solder} the wire to the board carefully.
translation: Нужно аккуратно припаять провод к плате.

definition: a person who introduces new ideas, methods or products
sentence: The company was founded by an {innovator} in battery design.
translation: Компанию основал новатор в области аккумуляторов.

definition: a warm, soft top with long sleeves that you pull over your head
sentence: He pulled on a grey {sweatshirt} and went for a run.
translation: Он натянул серую толстовку и пошёл на пробежку.

definition: to take back a statement you made, or to pull something back in
sentence: The newspaper had to {retract} its story about the minister.
translation: Газете пришлось отозвать статью о министре.

definition: to increase gradually over time, used of money or benefits
sentence: Interest will {accrue} on the loan from the first day.
translation: Проценты по займу будут начисляться с первого дня.

definition: to switch something off or make it stop working
sentence: You can {deactivate} your account without deleting your photos.
translation: Вы можете деактивировать аккаунт, не удаляя фотографии.

definition: to shine softly with reflected light
sentence: The wet rocks {gleam} in the morning sun.
translation: Мокрые камни блестят на утреннем солнце.

definition: a military leader who controls an area by force, outside the official government
sentence: The {warlord} ruled the valley with his private army.
translation: Полевой командир правил долиной с помощью своей армии.

definition: one of the two male organs that produce sperm
sentence: Doctors found a lump on the left {testicle} early enough to treat it.
translation: Врачи вовремя обнаружили уплотнение на левом яичке, чтобы его вылечить.

definition: to think that someone or something is bad or wrong
sentence: Her parents {disapprove} of her new boyfriend.
translation: Её родители не одобряют её нового парня.

definition: to claim something, often falsely, or to state a belief openly
sentence: They {profess} to love animals but keep the dog chained outside.
translation: Они заявляют, что любят животных, но держат собаку на цепи во дворе.

definition: with a taste like a lemon, or containing acid
sentence: Lemons are too {acidic} to eat on their own.
translation: Лимоны слишком кислые, чтобы есть их просто так.

definition: the act of following a rule, belief or plan closely
sentence: Strict {adherence} to the recipe gives the best bread.
translation: Строгое следование рецепту даёт лучший хлеб.

definition: to stop a meeting or trial for a time, planning to continue later
sentence: The judge decided to {adjourn} the trial until Monday.
translation: Судья решил отложить процесс до понедельника.

definition: a medical condition in which a person cannot remember things
sentence: After the crash he suffered from {amnesia} and did not know his name.
translation: После аварии он страдал амнезией и не знал своего имени.

definition: in an angry way
sentence: She slammed the door {angrily} and left.
translation: Она сердито хлопнула дверью и ушла.

definition: relating to courts that hear appeals against decisions of lower courts
sentence: The {appellate} court overturned the original sentence.
translation: Апелляционный суд отменил первоначальный приговор.

definition: the act of rising to an important position, or of going up to heaven
sentence: Her {ascension} to the post of director surprised nobody.
translation: Её восхождение на пост директора никого не удивило.

definition: a common drug that reduces pain and fever
sentence: Take an {aspirin} and lie down for an hour.
translation: Прими аспирин и полежи час.

definition: kind and generous, wishing to do good for others
sentence: A {benevolent} stranger paid for the old man's groceries.
translation: Добрый незнакомец оплатил покупки старика.

definition: a book or product that sells in very large numbers
sentence: Her first novel became a {bestseller} within a month.
translation: Её первый роман стал бестселлером за месяц.

definition: a continuous attack with bombs or shells, or a flood of questions or messages
sentence: The city survived three days of heavy {bombardment}.
translation: Город пережил три дня тяжёлой бомбардировки.

definition: very close to being something, but not clearly so
sentence: The joke was {borderline} offensive, and some guests did not laugh.
translation: Шутка была на грани оскорбления, и некоторые гости не смеялись.

definition: the act of checking and adjusting an instrument so that it measures correctly
sentence: The scales need {calibration} once a year.
translation: Весы нуждаются в калибровке раз в год.

definition: a strong personal charm that attracts and inspires other people
sentence: The young leader had a {charisma} that filled every hall.
translation: У молодого лидера была харизма, которая заполняла любой зал.

definition: the mental process of knowing, understanding and learning
sentence: Lack of sleep affects memory and {cognition}.
translation: Недостаток сна влияет на память и мышление.

definition: a large kitchen device for cooking food, with an oven and rings on top
sentence: The gas {cooker} is older than the house itself.
translation: Газовая плита старше самого дома.

definition: shaped like a tube or a can, with straight sides and round ends
sentence: The water tank is {cylindrical} and painted white.
translation: Бак для воды цилиндрический и выкрашен в белый.

definition: making you believe something that is not true
sentence: The calm sea was {deceptive}; a storm arrived within the hour.
translation: Спокойное море было обманчивым: шторм пришёл в течение часа.

definition: very great damage or destruction
sentence: The flood left {devastation} across three villages.
translation: Наводнение оставило разруху в трёх деревнях.

definition: believing strongly in a religion and following its rules carefully
sentence: A {devout} Muslim, he prays five times a day.
translation: Будучи набожным мусульманином, он молится пять раз в день.

definition: too large or too small compared with something else
sentence: The fine was {disproportionate} to such a small offense.
translation: Штраф был несоразмерен такому мелкому проступку.

definition: causing strong disagreement between people
sentence: Immigration remains a {divisive} issue in the election.
translation: Иммиграция остаётся вопросом, который раскалывает избирателей.

definition: a very hard, dark black wood
sentence: The piano keys were once made of {ebony} and ivory.
translation: Клавиши пианино когда-то делали из эбенового дерева и слоновой кости.

definition: to sew patterns or pictures onto cloth with colored thread
sentence: My grandmother used to {embroider} flowers on every pillow.
translation: Моя бабушка вышивала цветы на каждой подушке.

definition: changing suddenly and without reason; not regular or reliable
sentence: His {erratic} driving made the passengers nervous.
translation: Его хаотичное вождение нервировало пассажиров.

definition: a religious festival with music and dancing in Spain or Latin America
sentence: The whole town dances in the street during the {fiesta}.
translation: Весь город танцует на улице во время фиесты.

definition: able to be predicted or expected
sentence: Prices will stay high for the {foreseeable} future.
translation: Цены останутся высокими в обозримом будущем.

definition: wood from trees such as oak that is hard and used for furniture and floors
sentence: The living room has a polished {hardwood} floor.
translation: В гостиной полированный пол из твёрдых пород дерева.

definition: the ability to understand an event after it has happened
sentence: In {hindsight}, selling the house was a mistake.
translation: Оглядываясь назад, продажа дома была ошибкой.

definition: fear or hatred of gay people
sentence: The school has a clear policy against {homophobia} and bullying.
translation: В школе чёткая политика против гомофобии и травли.

definition: lack of interest or concern
sentence: The public greeted the new law with {indifference}.
translation: Публика встретила новый закон с безразличием.

definition: so important or useful that you cannot do without it
sentence: A good map is {indispensable} in these mountains.
translation: Хорошая карта незаменима в этих горах.

definition: a place in a school, prison or camp where sick people are treated
sentence: The injured boy was carried to the school {infirmary}.
translation: Раненого мальчика отнесли в школьный медпункт.

definition: extremely, in a way that seems crazy
sentence: The tickets were {insanely} expensive, but we went anyway.
translation: Билеты были безумно дорогими, но мы всё равно пошли.

definition: in a way that relates to thinking and understanding ideas
sentence: The job is {intellectually} demanding but pays badly.
translation: Работа требует больших умственных усилий, но плохо оплачивается.

definition: happening or existing between the stars
sentence: The probe is the first human object to reach {interstellar} space.
translation: Зонд — первый созданный человеком объект, достигший межзвёздного пространства.

definition: done without wanting or meaning to, or happening without control
sentence: He gave an {involuntary} cry when the needle went in.
translation: Он невольно вскрикнул, когда вошла игла.

definition: the act of officially giving out something, such as shares or documents
sentence: The {issuance} of new passports was stopped during the strike.
translation: Выдача новых паспортов была приостановлена во время забастовки.

definition: having a feeling on the skin that makes you want to scratch
sentence: The wool sweater made my neck {itchy}.
translation: От шерстяного свитера у меня чесалась шея.

definition: a military group that rules a country after taking power by force
sentence: The {junta} banned all political parties the day after the coup.
translation: Хунта запретила все политические партии на следующий день после переворота.

definition: the crime of publishing false statements that damage someone's reputation
sentence: The singer sued the magazine for {libel}.
translation: Певец подал в суд на журнал за клевету.

definition: the fact of looking like someone, or a picture of a person
sentence: The portrait is a good {likeness} of her father.
translation: Портрет очень похож на её отца.

definition: very high, or showing high moral ideas, sometimes too proud
sentence: The charity has the {lofty} goal of ending hunger in the city.
translation: У благотворительной организации возвышенная цель — покончить с голодом в городе.

definition: so foolish or unreasonable that it makes people laugh
sentence: It is {ludicrous} to charge ten dollars for a cup of tea.
translation: Нелепо брать десять долларов за чашку чая.

definition: a tall plant with large yellow grains, grown for food; corn
sentence: The farmers grow {maize} on the lower fields.
translation: Фермеры выращивают кукурузу на нижних полях.

definition: the wish to hurt or upset someone
sentence: She said it without {malice}, but it still hurt.
translation: Она сказала это без злого умысла, но всё равно было больно.

definition: to treat a person or group as unimportant and keep them out of power
sentence: Cuts to the bus service further {marginalize} people in the villages.
translation: Сокращение автобусов ещё больше отодвигает жителей деревень на обочину.

definition: military weapons, bombs and bullets
sentence: The factory made every {munition} the army needed.
translation: Завод выпускал все боеприпасы, которые нужны были армии.

definition: an enemy or opponent that you cannot beat, or a punishment you deserve
sentence: The detective finally caught his old {nemesis}.
translation: Детектив наконец поймал своего давнего заклятого врага.

definition: the quality of being new and different from anything before
sentence: The judges praised the {originality} of her design.
translation: Судьи похвалили оригинальность её дизайна.

definition: made to be beautiful rather than useful
sentence: The {ornamental} pond in the garden has no fish in it.
translation: В декоративном пруду в саду нет рыбы.

definition: relating to the organ behind the stomach that helps digest food
sentence: He was diagnosed with {pancreatic} cancer at sixty.
translation: В шестьдесят ему поставили диагноз рак поджелудочной железы.

definition: a shop that sells ice cream or does hair, or an old-fashioned sitting room
sentence: We bought cones at the ice cream {parlor} by the pier.
translation: Мы купили рожки в кафе-мороженом у пирса.

definition: the quality of continuing to try despite difficulties
sentence: It took years of {perseverance} to get the book published.
translation: Понадобились годы упорства, чтобы опубликовать книгу.

definition: hard to please because you only like certain things, especially food
sentence: My son is a {picky} eater who refuses anything green.
translation: Мой сын привередлив в еде и отказывается от всего зелёного.

definition: all the ordinary people who live in a country or area
sentence: The king feared the anger of the {populace}.
translation: Король боялся гнева народа.

definition: expensive
sentence: The hotel was a bit {pricey}, but the view was worth it.
translation: Отель был дороговат, но вид того стоил.

definition: the spreading of something, or the growing of new plants from old ones
sentence: Radio waves travel by {propagation} through the air.
translation: Радиоволны распространяются по воздуху.

definition: relating to drugs that change how you see things, or to bright, strange patterns
sentence: The album cover had a {psychedelic} swirl of pink and green.
translation: На обложке альбома был психоделический вихрь розового и зелёного.

definition: to arrange things in no particular order, by chance
sentence: The app will {randomize} the songs so the order is always new.
translation: Приложение перемешает песни, так что порядок всегда будет новым.

definition: a priest in charge of a church, or the head of a university or school
sentence: The {rector} welcomed the new students in the main hall.
translation: Ректор поприветствовал новых студентов в главном зале.

definition: typical of a king or queen; very grand and impressive
sentence: She entered with a {regal} air and took the best chair.
translation: Она вошла с царственным видом и заняла лучшее кресло.

definition: Einstein's theory about space, time and gravity, or the state of depending on something else
sentence: The theory of {relativity} says that time passes differently near a black hole.
translation: Теория относительности утверждает, что время идёт иначе рядом с чёрной дырой.

definition: a soft shine on a surface
sentence: The horse's coat had a healthy {sheen} after the brushing.
translation: После чистки шерсть лошади блестела здоровым блеском.

definition: the quality of being honest and meaning what you say
sentence: Nobody doubted the {sincerity} of his apology.
translation: Никто не сомневался в искренности его извинений.

definition: breaking a religious or moral law; very wrong
sentence: The priest called the party {sinful} and told them to go home.
translation: Священник назвал вечеринку греховной и велел всем идти домой.

definition: the crime of saying false things that damage someone's reputation
sentence: He threatened to sue for {slander} after the interview.
translation: Он пригрозил подать в суд за клевету после интервью.

definition: smooth, shiny and attractive in shape, often used of hair, animals or design
sentence: The new phone has a {sleek} design and a glass back.
translation: У нового телефона обтекаемый дизайн и стеклянная задняя панель.

definition: relating to both social and economic conditions
sentence: Children from a low {socioeconomic} background get less help at school.
translation: Дети из семей с низким социально-экономическим статусом получают меньше помощи в школе.

definition: in a natural, sudden way without planning
sentence: The crowd {spontaneously} began to sing the national anthem.
translation: Толпа стихийно запела национальный гимн.

definition: a large fish whose eggs are eaten as caviar
sentence: The {sturgeon} can live for a hundred years in the river.
translation: Осётр может прожить в реке сто лет.

definition: a list of the subjects covered in a course of study
sentence: The {syllabus} for the course is posted online before term starts.
translation: Программа курса выкладывается в интернете до начала семестра.

definition: relating to a written text
sentence: The two editions of the novel have small {textual} differences.
translation: В двух изданиях романа есть небольшие текстовые различия.

definition: not changed or influenced by something, or natural and sincere
sentence: The village was {unaffected} by the storm that hit the coast.
translation: Деревню не затронул шторм, обрушившийся на побережье.

definition: certainly true; impossible to argue against
sentence: The evidence of climate change is now {undeniable}.
translation: Свидетельства изменения климата теперь неоспоримы.

definition: watching carefully for danger or problems
sentence: Parents must stay {vigilant} near the swimming pool.
translation: Родители должны быть бдительны рядом с бассейном.

definition: a formal visit, or a parent's right to see a child after a divorce
sentence: The father was given {visitation} rights every second weekend.
translation: Отцу дали право на встречи с ребёнком каждые вторые выходные.

definition: having a lot of experience of life, or relating to money and possessions
sentence: His {worldly} aunt taught him how to order wine in French.
translation: Его умудрённая жизнью тётя научила его заказывать вино по-французски.

definition: to be a typical example of something, or to give an example
sentence: Her career seems to {exemplify} the power of hard work.
translation: Её карьера служит примером силы упорного труда.

definition: to disconnect a device from the electricity supply
sentence: Please {unplug} the iron before you leave the house.
translation: Пожалуйста, выключи утюг из розетки перед уходом из дома.

definition: one of the four matches whose winners go on to the semifinals
sentence: The team lost in the {quarterfinal} on penalties.
translation: Команда проиграла в четвертьфинале по пенальти.

definition: decayed plant and food waste used to make the soil richer
sentence: Put the vegetable peelings on the {compost} heap.
translation: Положи овощные очистки в компостную кучу.

definition: a short, funny play that makes fun of something
sentence: The students performed a {skit} about their teachers at the party.
translation: Студенты показали на вечеринке сценку про своих учителей.

definition: a person who secretly carries goods or people across a border illegally
sentence: The {smuggler} hid the cigarettes under the floor of the van.
translation: Контрабандист спрятал сигареты под полом фургона.

definition: to cut up a dead animal or plant in order to study it
sentence: In biology class we had to {dissect} a frog.
translation: На уроке биологии нам пришлось препарировать лягушку.

definition: a name, number or code that marks one thing as different from others
sentence: Each product has a unique {identifier} printed on the box.
translation: У каждого товара есть уникальный идентификатор, напечатанный на коробке.

definition: a serious and careless mistake
sentence: Sending the email to the whole company was a terrible {blunder}.
translation: Отправить письмо всей компании было ужасной оплошностью.

definition: a small old man with a beard in stories, or a garden statue of one
sentence: A plastic {gnome} with a red hat stood by the front door.
translation: Пластиковый гном в красной шапке стоял у входной двери.

definition: a large snake that kills animals by squeezing them
sentence: The {boa} wrapped itself around the branch and waited.
translation: Удав обвил ветку и затаился.

definition: a very large hole in a hill or under the ground
sentence: The river disappears into a {cavern} under the mountain.
translation: Река исчезает в пещере под горой.

definition: a small flat piece of wood used with others to cover a roof
sentence: A {shingle} blew off the roof in the storm.
translation: Во время бури с крыши сорвало дранку.

definition: to speak quietly and unclearly, often because you are annoyed
sentence: He began to {mutter} something about the price of parking.
translation: Он начал бормотать что-то о цене парковки.

definition: to stop existing as a group, or to break a group up
sentence: The band decided to {disband} after twenty years together.
translation: Группа решила распасться после двадцати лет вместе.

definition: a person who believes in following the original rules of a religion very strictly
sentence: The {fundamentalist} rejected every modern reading of the holy book.
translation: Фундаменталист отвергал любое современное прочтение священной книги.

definition: to make something necessary
sentence: The new rules will {necessitate} extra staff at the airport.
translation: Новые правила потребуют дополнительного персонала в аэропорту.

definition: a runner who races over short distances at high speed
sentence: The {sprinter} broke the national record in the hundred meters.
translation: Спринтер побил национальный рекорд на стометровке.

definition: goods stolen by force, especially during a war, or the act of stealing them
sentence: The pirates divided the {plunder} on the beach.
translation: Пираты делили добычу на пляже.

definition: to speak with difficulty, repeating the first sounds of words
sentence: He began to {stutter} when the teacher asked him a question.
translation: Он начал заикаться, когда учитель задал ему вопрос.

definition: to give a person, animal or plant the food it needs to grow
sentence: Rich soil helps {nourish} the young trees.
translation: Богатая почва помогает питать молодые деревья.

definition: to become longer or make something longer
sentence: The tailor will {lengthen} the trousers by two centimeters.
translation: Портной удлинит брюки на два сантиметра.

definition: a stick of colored wax used by children for drawing
sentence: The toddler drew on the wall with a red {crayon}.
translation: Малыш нарисовал на стене красным восковым мелком.

definition: praise or an award given for great achievement
sentence: The chef received the highest {accolade} in French cooking.
translation: Шеф-повар получил высшую награду во французской кухне.

definition: very skilled at something
sentence: She is {adept} at calming angry customers.
translation: Она умеет ловко успокаивать сердитых клиентов.

definition: giving a benefit or putting you in a better position
sentence: The shop's position near the station is highly {advantageous}.
translation: Расположение магазина рядом с вокзалом очень выгодно.

definition: floating on water, or having enough money to continue
sentence: The crew kept the damaged boat {afloat} until help arrived.
translation: Экипаж держал повреждённую лодку на плаву, пока не пришла помощь.

definition: the ability to move quickly and easily
sentence: Gymnastics requires balance, strength and {agility}.
translation: Гимнастика требует равновесия, силы и ловкости.

definition: the feeling of being slightly angry, or something that causes it
sentence: To her {annoyance}, the bus left just as she reached the stop.
translation: К её досаде, автобус уехал ровно в тот момент, когда она дошла до остановки.

definition: a group of islands
sentence: The {archipelago} has over a thousand islands, most of them empty.
translation: В архипелаге больше тысячи островов, большинство из них необитаемы.

definition: to become larger and rounder because of gas or water inside
sentence: Fizzy drinks make my stomach {bloat} after a big meal.
translation: От газировки у меня раздувается живот после плотного обеда.

definition: a large outdoor fire made for burning rubbish or as part of a celebration
sentence: We sat around the {bonfire} singing until midnight.
translation: Мы сидели у костра и пели до полуночи.

definition: relating to the relationship between a cause and its effect
sentence: The study found a {causal} link between smoking and the disease.
translation: Исследование выявило причинную связь между курением и болезнью.

definition: in or near the center of a place, or from one central point
sentence: The flat is {centrally} located, five minutes from the main square.
translation: Квартира расположена в центре, в пяти минутах от главной площади.

definition: a fortress on high ground that protects a city
sentence: The old {citadel} looks down on the harbor from the cliff.
translation: Старая цитадель смотрит на гавань с утёса.

definition: the policy of one country controlling and settling other lands
sentence: The museum does not hide the cruelty of {colonialism}.
translation: Музей не скрывает жестокости колониализма.

definition: the panel in front of a driver with dials, lights and controls
sentence: A red warning light appeared on the {dashboard}.
translation: На приборной панели загорелась красная лампочка.

definition: not having enough of something, or not good enough
sentence: Her diet was {deficient} in iron, so she felt tired.
translation: В её рационе не хватало железа, поэтому она чувствовала усталость.

definition: to become worse in quality or condition
sentence: The friendly debate began to {degenerate} into a shouting match.
translation: Дружеская дискуссия стала перерастать в перепалку.

definition: relating to or like a devil; evil
sentence: The villain laughed with a {demonic} grin.
translation: Злодей засмеялся с дьявольской усмешкой.

definition: something that makes people less likely to do something bad
sentence: A camera above the door is a good {deterrent} to thieves.
translation: Камера над дверью хорошо отпугивает воров.

definition: to feel that someone or something does not deserve your respect
sentence: The old chef seemed to {disdain} every modern kitchen gadget.
translation: Старый шеф, казалось, презирал каждый современный кухонный гаджет.

definition: so bad that people should be ashamed of it
sentence: The state of the toilets was {disgraceful}.
translation: Состояние туалетов было позорным.

definition: strange and frightening in a mysterious way
sentence: An {eerie} silence hung over the empty street.
translation: Над пустой улицей висела жуткая тишина.

definition: to make someone extremely angry
sentence: The referee's decision seemed to {enrage} the home fans.
translation: Решение судьи, похоже, привело домашних болельщиков в ярость.

definition: growing faster and faster, by a constant factor each time
sentence: The city has seen {exponential} growth in bike use.
translation: Город наблюдает экспоненциальный рост использования велосипедов.

definition: a funny play full of silly situations, or a ridiculous event
sentence: The trial became a {farce} when the main witness fell asleep.
translation: Процесс превратился в фарс, когда главный свидетель уснул.

definition: in a way that causes death, or that leads to complete failure
sentence: The driver was {fatally} injured in the crash.
translation: Водитель получил смертельные травмы в аварии.

definition: extremely worried, hurried or excited
sentence: The parents made a {frantic} search of the beach for the lost boy.
translation: Родители лихорадочно обыскивали пляж в поисках потерявшегося мальчика.

definition: extremely, used of something bad or wrong
sentence: The hospital was {grossly} understaffed on the night of the accident.
translation: В ночь аварии в больнице катастрофически не хватало персонала.

definition: written by hand rather than typed or printed
sentence: She keeps a {handwritten} letter from her grandfather in the drawer.
translation: Она хранит в ящике письмо, написанное рукой дедушки.

definition: cruel and without any kindness
sentence: It was {heartless} to leave the dog outside in the snow.
translation: Бессердечно было оставить собаку на улице в снегу.

definition: very busy and full of activity
sentence: December is always a {hectic} month at the post office.
translation: Декабрь на почте всегда суматошный месяц.

definition: dealing with the whole of something, especially a person, rather than parts
sentence: The clinic takes a {holistic} approach, treating diet and stress as well as symptoms.
translation: Клиника применяет целостный подход, занимаясь питанием и стрессом, а не только симптомами.

definition: relating to or caused by hormones, the chemicals that control the body
sentence: Teenagers go through big {hormonal} changes.
translation: Подростки переживают большие гормональные изменения.

definition: affecting someone's private life or attention in an unwelcome way
sentence: The reporters' questions about her divorce were {intrusive}.
translation: Вопросы репортёров о её разводе были бесцеремонными.

definition: full of joy; very happy
sentence: The birth of the twins was a {joyous} event for the whole family.
translation: Рождение близнецов стало радостным событием для всей семьи.

definition: a small fruit with brown hairy skin and green flesh
sentence: Cut a {kiwi} in half and eat it with a spoon.
translation: Разрежь киви пополам и ешь ложкой.

definition: a long, luxurious car, often with a driver
sentence: The bride arrived at the church in a white {limo}.
translation: Невеста приехала в церковь на белом лимузине.

definition: the time in the middle of the day when people eat lunch
sentence: The shop closes for an hour at {lunchtime}.
translation: Магазин закрывается на час в обеденное время.

definition: very dangerous and likely to spread, used of cancer
sentence: The tests showed the tumor was {malignant}.
translation: Анализы показали, что опухоль злокачественная.

definition: the long hair on the neck of a horse or lion
sentence: The lion shook its golden {mane} and roared.
translation: Лев тряхнул золотой гривой и зарычал.

definition: a dark substance put on the eyelashes to make them look longer and thicker
sentence: Her {mascara} ran when she started to cry.
translation: Её тушь потекла, когда она заплакала.

definition: the act of bringing two people together in the hope that they will marry
sentence: My aunt loves {matchmaking} and has introduced three couples.
translation: Моя тётя обожает сводить людей и познакомила уже три пары.

definition: an infectious disease, mainly of children, causing fever and red spots
sentence: The school closed after an outbreak of {measles}.
translation: Школу закрыли после вспышки кори.

definition: relating to very small living things such as bacteria
sentence: The soil is full of {microbial} life that helps plants grow.
translation: Почва полна микробной жизни, которая помогает растениям расти.

definition: melted into liquid by great heat, used of metal or rock
sentence: Red {molten} lava poured down the side of the volcano.
translation: Красная расплавленная лава стекала по склону вулкана.

definition: the season of heavy rain in South Asia, or the wind that brings it
sentence: The {monsoon} floods the streets of the city every July.
translation: Муссон затапливает улицы города каждый июль.

definition: a picture or film made by putting several separate images together
sentence: The film opens with a {montage} of the city at dawn.
translation: Фильм начинается с монтажа кадров города на рассвете.

definition: not giving enough care or attention, so that harm is caused
sentence: The court found the doctor {negligent} in his treatment of the boy.
translation: Суд признал врача халатным в лечении мальчика.

definition: with very strong feelings or beliefs
sentence: She argued {passionately} for better pay for nurses.
translation: Она страстно выступала за лучшую оплату труда медсестёр.

definition: the act of making someone agree to do or believe something
sentence: It took a lot of {persuasion} to get him on the plane.
translation: Потребовалось много уговоров, чтобы посадить его в самолёт.

definition: a pattern of crossing lines in different colors, often on wool cloth
sentence: He wore a red {plaid} shirt and heavy boots.
translation: На нём была красная клетчатая рубашка и тяжёлые ботинки.

definition: the act of playing a recording of sound or video
sentence: During the {playback}, we noticed a strange noise on the tape.
translation: Во время воспроизведения мы заметили странный шум на плёнке.

definition: very comfortable, soft and expensive
sentence: The hotel room had a {plush} carpet and silk curtains.
translation: В номере отеля был роскошный ковёр и шёлковые шторы.

definition: the practice of being hopeful and seeing the good in things
sentence: Her {positivity} kept the team going through the long project.
translation: Её позитивный настрой помогал команде держаться весь долгий проект.

definition: the condition of being more important and dealt with first
sentence: Safety takes {precedence} over speed on this site.
translation: Безопасность на этом объекте важнее скорости.

definition: perfectly clean, new or unspoiled
sentence: The beach was {pristine}, without a single piece of plastic.
translation: Пляж был нетронутым, без единого кусочка пластика.

definition: a doctor's opinion about how an illness will develop
sentence: With early treatment, the {prognosis} is good.
translation: При раннем лечении прогноз благоприятный.

definition: in a way that accepts the real situation rather than what you wish
sentence: {Realistically}, we cannot finish the house before winter.
translation: Реально говоря, мы не сможем закончить дом до зимы.

definition: the act of changing the way a company or system is arranged
sentence: The {reorganization} of the department cost twenty jobs.
translation: Реорганизация отдела стоила двадцати рабочих мест.

definition: the act of getting something back, especially information from a computer
sentence: The lost files are beyond {retrieval} after the fire.
translation: Потерянные файлы невозможно восстановить после пожара.

definition: a mixture of salt and water used in medicine
sentence: The nurse cleaned the wound with {saline}.
translation: Медсестра промыла рану физраствором.

definition: only just, almost not
sentence: I had {scarcely} sat down when the phone rang.
translation: Едва я сел, как зазвонил телефон.

definition: the industry of building ships
sentence: The town lived on {shipbuilding} until the yard closed in 1980.
translation: Город жил судостроением, пока верфь не закрылась в 1980 году.

definition: full of or smelling of the grey cloud that rises from a fire
sentence: The bar was so {smoky} that my eyes hurt.
translation: В баре было так накурено, что у меня болели глаза.

definition: to remove the ovaries of a female animal so it cannot have young
sentence: The shelter will {spay} every cat before it is adopted.
translation: Приют стерилизует каждую кошку, прежде чем её заберут.

definition: never very hot or very cold, used of climate
sentence: Britain has a {temperate} climate with rain in every season.
translation: В Британии умеренный климат с дождями в любое время года.

definition: relating to the subject or main idea of a piece of work
sentence: The exhibition is arranged in {thematic} rooms: war, love and childhood.
translation: Выставка разделена на тематические залы: война, любовь и детство.

definition: an electric machine that makes slices of bread brown and crisp
sentence: The {toaster} burned the bread again this morning.
translation: Тостер снова сжёг хлеб сегодня утром.

definition: a bright greenish-blue color, or the stone of that color
sentence: The sea near the island was a clear {turquoise}.
translation: Море у острова было прозрачно-бирюзовым.

definition: light with very short waves that the eye cannot see and that burns the skin
sentence: The lamp gives off {ultraviolet} that kills bacteria.
translation: Лампа излучает ультрафиолет, который убивает бактерии.

definition: fair, not influenced by personal feelings or opinions
sentence: We need an {unbiased} judge for the competition.
translation: Нам нужен беспристрастный судья для конкурса.

definition: strange and hard to explain, often in a slightly frightening way
sentence: She has an {uncanny} ability to guess what people are thinking.
translation: У неё сверхъестественная способность угадывать, о чём думают люди.

definition: not showing thanks for something you have been given
sentence: It would be {ungrateful} to complain after all their help.
translation: Было бы неблагодарно жаловаться после всей их помощи.

definition: not given medical treatment, or not processed with chemicals
sentence: Left {untreated}, the infection can spread to the bone.
translation: Без лечения инфекция может распространиться на кость.

definition: the quality of being helpful or able to be used for a purpose
sentence: The old map has lost its {usefulness} since the roads changed.
translation: Старая карта потеряла свою полезность, с тех пор как изменились дороги.

definition: the crime of deliberately damaging public or private property
sentence: The bus shelter was destroyed by {vandalism} twice this year.
translation: Остановку в этом году дважды разрушали вандалы.

definition: a person who makes a long journey, especially by sea or into space
sentence: The old {voyager} had sailed around the world twice.
translation: Старый мореплаватель дважды обошёл вокруг света.

definition: not fair, not legal or not deserved
sentence: She sued the company for {wrongful} dismissal.
translation: Она подала на компанию в суд за незаконное увольнение.

definition: a path, often raised or covered, for people to walk along
sentence: A covered {walkway} connects the station to the shopping center.
translation: Крытый переход соединяет вокзал с торговым центром.

definition: a growth like a small bag of liquid that forms inside or on the body
sentence: The doctor removed a small {cyst} from her wrist.
translation: Врач удалил небольшую кисту с её запястья.

definition: a rare or special food that is very good to eat
sentence: Snails are a {delicacy} in some parts of France.
translation: Улитки — деликатес в некоторых частях Франции.

definition: to reduce or limit something
sentence: The council plans to {curtail} parking in the old town.
translation: Совет планирует ограничить парковку в старом городе.

definition: a substance, such as salt in water, that carries an electric current
sentence: Sports drinks replace every {electrolyte} you lose in sweat.
translation: Спортивные напитки восполняют электролиты, потерянные с потом.

definition: a person who moves from place to place instead of living in one home
sentence: The {nomad} packed his tent and followed the herd north.
translation: Кочевник собрал палатку и пошёл за стадом на север.

definition: to move quickly and lightly up and down or from side to side
sentence: Flags {flutter} in the wind above the stadium.
translation: Флаги трепещут на ветру над стадионом.

definition: to become hard or solid, or to make an idea or position firm
sentence: The wax will {solidify} as it cools.
translation: Воск затвердеет, когда остынет.

definition: a state of being unable to think clearly, after a shock or blow
sentence: He walked around in a {daze} after hearing the news.
translation: Он ходил как в тумане после того, как услышал новость.

definition: a person whose beliefs go against the official teaching of a religion
sentence: The church burned the {heretic} for his writings.
translation: Церковь сожгла еретика за его сочинения.

definition: a small broken piece of glass or pottery with cutting edges
sentence: A {shard} of glass cut her foot in the kitchen.
translation: Осколок стекла порезал ей ногу на кухне.

definition: a round metal or plastic container with a lid, for storing or spraying something
sentence: The police fired a tear gas {canister} into the crowd.
translation: Полиция выпустила в толпу баллон со слезоточивым газом.

definition: a speech sound or letter that is not a vowel, such as b or t
sentence: The word "strength" has only one vowel and seven {consonant} letters.
translation: В слове «strength» всего одна гласная и семь согласных букв.

definition: a very thin wire or thread, such as the one inside an old light bulb
sentence: The {filament} in the old bulb finally burned out.
translation: Нить накала в старой лампочке наконец перегорела.

definition: to change the time of a planned event
sentence: We had to {reschedule} the meeting because of the strike.
translation: Нам пришлось перенести встречу из-за забастовки.

definition: a person who sees something happen but is not involved in it
sentence: A {bystander} filmed the arrest on her phone.
translation: Прохожая сняла задержание на телефон.

definition: the explosive front part of a missile or bomb
sentence: The missile can carry a nuclear {warhead}.
translation: Ракета может нести ядерную боеголовку.

definition: a smaller group within a larger group
sentence: Women over sixty formed a separate {subgroup} in the study.
translation: Женщины старше шестидесяти составили отдельную подгруппу в исследовании.

definition: a long stick that fits under the arm to help a hurt person walk
sentence: He walked with a {crutch} for six weeks after breaking his leg.
translation: После перелома ноги он шесть недель ходил с костылём.

definition: a feeling or idea that a word suggests beyond its basic meaning
sentence: The word "cheap" has a negative {connotation} of poor quality.
translation: Слово «дешёвый» имеет негативный оттенок плохого качества.

definition: to check and adjust an instrument so that it measures correctly
sentence: Engineers {calibrate} the sensors before every launch.
translation: Инженеры калибруют датчики перед каждым запуском.

definition: a small, red, sour fruit used in sauce and juice
sentence: Turkey is often served with {cranberry} sauce.
translation: Индейку часто подают с клюквенным соусом.

definition: to leave your own country to live permanently in another
sentence: Her grandparents decided to {emigrate} to Canada after the war.
translation: Её бабушка и дедушка решили эмигрировать в Канаду после войны.

definition: a person or company that owes money
sentence: The bank sends a reminder to each {debtor} every month.
translation: Банк каждый месяц отправляет напоминание каждому должнику.

definition: a person or company that brings goods into a country to sell
sentence: The {importer} buys coffee beans directly from farms in Brazil.
translation: Импортёр покупает кофейные зёрна напрямую у ферм в Бразилии.

definition: a phrase or idea that has been used so often that it is boring
sentence: "Time heals all wounds" is a {cliche}, but it is often true.
translation: «Время лечит» — штамп, но часто это правда.

definition: a strong feeling that someone or something is stupid or worthless
sentence: He spoke of the new fashion with open {scorn}.
translation: Он говорил о новой моде с открытым презрением.

definition: a number or amount that is close to the exact one but not exact
sentence: Two hundred guests is only an {approximation}; we have not counted.
translation: Двести гостей — лишь приблизительная оценка, мы не считали.

definition: having a strong, pleasant smell
sentence: The kitchen was full of {aromatic} herbs from the garden.
translation: Кухня была полна ароматных трав из сада.

definition: in the highly decorated style of European art and music of the 17th century
sentence: The church has a {baroque} ceiling covered in gold and angels.
translation: В церкви барочный потолок, покрытый золотом и ангелами.

definition: without thinking or understanding, or without being able to see
sentence: Do not {blindly} trust everything you read online.
translation: Не доверяй слепо всему, что читаешь в интернете.

definition: accepted as one of the most important or standard works or rules
sentence: The novel is now part of the {canonical} reading list in schools.
translation: Роман теперь входит в канонический список чтения в школах.

definition: in a careful way to avoid danger or mistakes
sentence: She {cautiously} opened the door and looked inside.
translation: Она осторожно открыла дверь и заглянула внутрь.

definition: a green plant with long, hard, wet stems that you eat raw or in soup
sentence: Chop a stick of {celery} and add it to the soup.
translation: Нарежь стебель сельдерея и добавь в суп.

definition: to touch something lightly and quickly, often with a cloth
sentence: Gently {dab} the wound with a clean tissue.
translation: Аккуратно промокни рану чистой салфеткой.

definition: the feeling of not being pleased with something
sentence: There is growing {dissatisfaction} with the slow trains.
translation: Растёт недовольство медленными поездами.

definition: relating to life on Earth rather than heaven, or possible at all
sentence: He gave up all {earthly} goods and became a monk.
translation: Он отказался от всех земных благ и стал монахом.

definition: a rapid increase in the strength or seriousness of something
sentence: Both sides warned against a further {escalation} of the conflict.
translation: Обе стороны предостерегли от дальнейшей эскалации конфликта.

definition: the set of beliefs and attitudes typical of a group or organization
sentence: The school has an {ethos} of kindness and hard work.
translation: В школе царит дух доброты и трудолюбия.

definition: lasting only a very short time
sentence: I caught a {fleeting} glimpse of the deer before it ran.
translation: Я лишь мельком увидел оленя, прежде чем он убежал.

definition: a factory where metal is melted and poured into shapes
sentence: The {foundry} made bells for churches across the country.
translation: Литейный завод отливал колокола для церквей по всей стране.

definition: a book with a stiff cover, usually more expensive than a paperback
sentence: The {hardcover} came out a year before the cheap edition.
translation: Издание в твёрдом переплёте вышло за год до дешёвого.

definition: to put someone into a high office with a ceremony, or to open something officially
sentence: The city will {inaugurate} the new bridge with fireworks on Sunday.
translation: Город торжественно откроет новый мост фейерверком в воскресенье.

definition: relating to the long tube in the body that digests food
sentence: The patient suffered from an {intestinal} infection after the trip.
translation: Пациент страдал от кишечной инфекции после поездки.

definition: extremely excited and full of energy, often in an uncontrolled way
sentence: The shop was {manic} on the last day before Christmas.
translation: В последний день перед Рождеством в магазине было безумие.

definition: large enough to be measured or noticed
sentence: The new rules had a {measurable} effect on road accidents.
translation: Новые правила оказали ощутимое влияние на число ДТП.

definition: soft, pleasant and relaxed, used of sounds, colors, tastes or people
sentence: The band played {mellow} jazz while we ate.
translation: Группа играла мягкий джаз, пока мы ели.

definition: the telling of a story, or the voice that describes what happens in a film
sentence: The film's {narration} is spoken by an old fisherman.
translation: Закадровый текст фильма читает старый рыбак.

definition: the state of being completely forgotten, or of being unconscious
sentence: Many popular songs of the time have sunk into {oblivion}.
translation: Многие популярные песни того времени канули в забвение.

definition: a person who goes to a hospital for treatment but does not stay the night
sentence: She is treated as an {outpatient} twice a week.
translation: Её лечат амбулаторно два раза в неделю.

definition: the practice of giving money and help to people who need it
sentence: After selling his company, he devoted himself to {philanthropy}.
translation: Продав компанию, он посвятил себя благотворительности.

definition: the state of being ready for something, especially an emergency
sentence: The city tested its {preparedness} for an earthquake.
translation: Город проверил свою готовность к землетрясению.

definition: relating to the most basic needs and feelings of humans and animals
sentence: Fear of the dark is a {primal} instinct.
translation: Страх темноты — первобытный инстинкт.

definition: willing to listen to and accept new ideas or suggestions
sentence: The new manager is {receptive} to ideas from the staff.
translation: Новый менеджер открыт для идей сотрудников.

definition: the loss of a job because the worker is no longer needed
sentence: The factory announced the {redundancy} of three hundred workers.
translation: Завод объявил о сокращении трёхсот рабочих.

definition: the act of electing someone again to the same position
sentence: The mayor is running for {reelection} next spring.
translation: Мэр будет переизбираться следующей весной.

definition: a large deer with big antlers that lives in cold northern regions
sentence: The {reindeer} pulls the sled across the frozen lake.
translation: Северный олень тянет сани по замёрзшему озеру.

definition: to become ill again after getting better, or to return to a bad habit
sentence: Without support, many patients {relapse} within a year.
translation: Без поддержки многие пациенты срываются в течение года.

definition: a cold sauce of chopped vegetables or fruit, or great enjoyment
sentence: He ate the hot dog with {relish} and extra onions.
translation: Он ел хот-дог с соусом релиш и дополнительным луком.

definition: an arrangement to meet someone at a particular place and time
sentence: The spies had a secret {rendezvous} in the park at midnight.
translation: У шпионов была тайная встреча в парке в полночь.

definition: able to be changed back to how it was before
sentence: The damage to the forest is not {reversible}.
translation: Ущерб лесу необратим.

definition: choosing only certain things and not others
sentence: The report quotes the data {selectively} to support its claim.
translation: В отчёте данные цитируются выборочно, чтобы подтвердить свой тезис.

definition: treating a complex problem as if it were simple
sentence: Blaming the teachers alone is a {simplistic} view of the problem.
translation: Винить одних учителей — упрощённый взгляд на проблему.

definition: the practice of keeping the skin healthy and attractive
sentence: Her morning {skincare} routine takes twenty minutes.
translation: Её утренний уход за кожей занимает двадцать минут.

definition: relating to watching over and directing the work of others
sentence: She moved into a {supervisory} role after five years on the line.
translation: Через пять лет на конвейере она перешла на руководящую должность.

definition: very dangerous though it seems safe, or not loyal
sentence: The road over the pass is {treacherous} in icy weather.
translation: Дорога через перевал коварна в гололёд.

definition: too much or too many to be counted or described
sentence: The war caused {untold} suffering across the region.
translation: Война принесла региону неисчислимые страдания.

definition: to give a person or animal an injection that protects against a disease
sentence: The clinic will {vaccinate} all the children under five for free.
translation: Клиника бесплатно привьёт всех детей до пяти лет.

definition: the ability to do many different things or be used in many ways
sentence: The actor is known for his {versatility} in comedy and drama.
translation: Актёр известен своей универсальностью в комедии и драме.

definition: the act of forming a picture in your mind, or a picture that shows data
sentence: The chart is a clear {visualization} of the sales figures.
translation: График — наглядное представление данных о продажах.

definition: a system that records phone messages, or a message left on it
sentence: I left a {voicemail} asking her to call me back.
translation: Я оставил голосовое сообщение с просьбой перезвонить.

definition: a connection or relationship between two things
sentence: There is a clear {linkage} between poverty and poor health.
translation: Есть явная связь между бедностью и плохим здоровьем.

definition: to speak very quietly, so that the words are hard to hear
sentence: She bent down to {murmur} something in the child's ear.
translation: Она наклонилась, чтобы прошептать что-то ребёнку на ухо.

definition: to cry loudly and for a long time because of pain or sadness
sentence: The baby began to {wail} as soon as the car stopped.
translation: Младенец начал громко плакать, как только машина остановилась.

definition: a person you share a house with who is not family
sentence: My {housemate} leaves dirty dishes in the sink for days.
translation: Мой сосед по дому оставляет грязную посуду в раковине на несколько дней.

definition: to make something happen faster
sentence: Paying a fee can {expedite} the visa process by two weeks.
translation: Оплата сбора может ускорить получение визы на две недели.

definition: a slight shaking of the ground, or of a part of the body
sentence: A small {tremor} shook the plates on the shelf.
translation: Лёгкий толчок встряхнул тарелки на полке.

definition: a person who broadcasts live video of themselves online, often playing games
sentence: The {streamer} has two million followers who watch her play.
translation: У стримерши два миллиона подписчиков, которые смотрят, как она играет.

definition: a flying insect that produces light from its body at night
sentence: A {firefly} glowed above the grass in the warm darkness.
translation: Светлячок мерцал над травой в тёплой темноте.

definition: to get a response, answer or reaction from someone
sentence: The question failed to {elicit} any answer from the minister.
translation: Вопрос не вызвал у министра никакого ответа.

definition: to go away slowly until nothing is left, like fog or anger
sentence: The morning fog will {dissipate} by ten o'clock.
translation: Утренний туман рассеется к десяти часам.

definition: to send out liquid in a strong stream, or to talk at length about something
sentence: The whale began to {spout} water high into the air.
translation: Кит стал выбрасывать воду высоко в воздух.

definition: to agree with someone or something
sentence: The second doctor seemed to {concur} with the diagnosis.
translation: Второй врач, по-видимому, согласился с диагнозом.

definition: to become gradually smaller or fewer
sentence: The crowd began to {dwindle} as the rain got heavier.
translation: Толпа начала редеть, когда дождь усилился.

definition: a rare and expensive fungus that grows underground, or a soft chocolate sweet
sentence: The chef shaved a black {truffle} over the pasta.
translation: Шеф-повар настрогал чёрный трюфель над пастой.

definition: a person who studies plants and animals in nature
sentence: The {naturalist} spent years watching birds on the island.
translation: Натуралист годами наблюдал за птицами на острове.

definition: a person who has stopped working because of age
sentence: The town is popular with every {retiree} looking for sun and quiet.
translation: Город популярен у пенсионеров, которые ищут солнца и тишины.

definition: to become less like water and more like cream
sentence: Stir the sauce until it begins to {thicken}.
translation: Помешивай соус, пока он не начнёт густеть.

definition: to damage something very badly
sentence: Fire continued to {ravage} the forest for a week.
translation: Огонь неделю опустошал лес.

definition: a quiet person who prefers to be alone rather than with other people
sentence: As an {introvert}, she finds big parties exhausting.
translation: Как интроверт, она находит большие вечеринки изматывающими.

definition: to cut food, especially meat, into very small pieces
sentence: You need to {mince} the garlic very finely for this dish.
translation: Для этого блюда чеснок нужно очень мелко порубить.

definition: to make a loud, high, unpleasant sound
sentence: The brakes began to {screech} as the bus stopped.
translation: Тормоза завизжали, когда автобус остановился.

definition: a place where medicines are prepared and given out
sentence: The village {dispensary} opens three mornings a week.
translation: Деревенская аптека работает три утра в неделю.

definition: to stop something from having an effect
sentence: Baking soda will {neutralize} the acid in the soil.
translation: Пищевая сода нейтрализует кислоту в почве.

definition: something that shows what is likely to happen in the future
sentence: Family income is a strong {predictor} of exam results.
translation: Доход семьи — сильный предиктор результатов экзаменов.

definition: caused by or resulting from something
sentence: Half the deaths were {attributable} to smoking.
translation: Половина смертей была связана с курением.

definition: a place or organization that strongly defends a belief or way of life
sentence: The club was the last {bastion} of the old rules.
translation: Клуб был последним бастионом старых правил.

definition: the removal of a small piece of body tissue to test it for disease
sentence: The {biopsy} showed that the lump was not cancer.
translation: Биопсия показала, что уплотнение не является раком.

definition: thick and solid, or made of large pieces
sentence: He wore a {chunky} gold watch on his wrist.
translation: На его запястье были массивные золотые часы.

definition: well connected so that all the parts work together as one
sentence: The new coach built a {cohesive} team out of strangers.
translation: Новый тренер собрал сплочённую команду из незнакомых людей.

definition: causing or likely to cause a lot of disagreement
sentence: The new tax is the most {contentious} issue in the budget.
translation: Новый налог — самый спорный вопрос в бюджете.

definition: to make lines in cloth or paper by folding or pressing it
sentence: Hang the shirt up so it does not {crease}.
translation: Повесь рубашку, чтобы она не помялась.

definition: the condition of not having enough water in the body
sentence: Two runners were treated for {dehydration} after the race.
translation: Двух бегунов лечили от обезвоживания после гонки.

definition: the process by which the body breaks down food
sentence: A short walk after dinner helps {digestion}.
translation: Короткая прогулка после ужина помогает пищеварению.

definition: an official order that stops trade with a particular country
sentence: The oil {embargo} lasted for almost a year.
translation: Нефтяное эмбарго длилось почти год.

definition: a person or thing that represents a quality or idea perfectly
sentence: The old teacher was the {embodiment} of patience.
translation: Старый учитель был воплощением терпения.

definition: to make an idea, habit or position so fixed that it is hard to change
sentence: Years of low pay helped {entrench} poverty in the region.
translation: Годы низких зарплат закрепили бедность в регионе.

definition: giving the reasons for something or making it clear
sentence: Each chart comes with an {explanatory} note.
translation: К каждому графику прилагается пояснительная записка.

definition: the holding of extreme political or religious views
sentence: The government opened a program to fight {extremism} online.
translation: Правительство запустило программу борьбы с экстремизмом в интернете.

definition: the process of passing a liquid or gas through a filter to clean it
sentence: The pool uses sand {filtration} to keep the water clear.
translation: В бассейне песчаная фильтрация поддерживает чистоту воды.

definition: caused by or relating to a fungus, such as mold or mushrooms
sentence: A {fungal} infection turned his toenail yellow.
translation: Грибковая инфекция сделала его ноготь жёлтым.

definition: a feeling of deep sadness and no hope, or near darkness
sentence: A mood of {gloom} settled over the office after the layoffs.
translation: После сокращений в офисе воцарилось уныние.

definition: claiming to have beliefs or standards that you do not really follow
sentence: It is {hypocritical} to preach saving while flying every weekend.
translation: Лицемерно проповедовать экономию, летая каждые выходные.

definition: famous and respected because of great things done in the past
sentence: The hotel has hosted many {illustrious} guests, including two presidents.
translation: В отеле останавливались многие прославленные гости, включая двух президентов.

definition: happening in connection with something more important, by chance
sentence: The noise was an {incidental} problem; the real issue was the cost.
translation: Шум был второстепенной проблемой, главным был вопрос цены.

definition: a dark blue color, or the plant dye of that color
sentence: The evening sky turned a deep {indigo} over the sea.
translation: Вечернее небо над морем стало тёмно-синим, цвета индиго.

definition: a violent attempt by a group to take control from a government
sentence: The {insurgency} spread from the mountains to the capital.
translation: Повстанческое движение распространилось с гор до столицы.

definition: something that is not correct or not according to the rules
sentence: Auditors found an {irregularity} in the company's accounts.
translation: Аудиторы нашли нарушение в отчётности компании.

definition: a complicated network of paths or passages in which it is easy to get lost
sentence: The old town is a {labyrinth} of narrow streets and stairs.
translation: Старый город — лабиринт узких улиц и лестниц.

definition: the delay before data starts to move after an instruction is given
sentence: Online games need low {latency} to feel smooth.
translation: Онлайн-играм нужна низкая задержка, чтобы всё шло плавно.

definition: a state of uncertainty in which nothing can be decided or done
sentence: The workers are in {limbo} until the company announces its plans.
translation: Рабочие в подвешенном состоянии, пока компания не объявит планы.

definition: very bad or of poor quality
sentence: The food was {lousy} and the service even worse.
translation: Еда была паршивой, а обслуживание ещё хуже.

definition: a box where letters are delivered, or a place where email is stored
sentence: The {mailbox} was full of bills and advertisements.
translation: Почтовый ящик был полон счетов и рекламы.

definition: objects that people collect because they are connected with a famous person or event
sentence: His room is full of football {memorabilia}, from shirts to old tickets.
translation: Его комната полна футбольных памятных вещей, от футболок до старых билетов.

definition: the nose and mouth of an animal, or a cover put over them
sentence: The dog must wear a {muzzle} on the train.
translation: В поезде собака должна быть в наморднике.

definition: not noticing or not aware of what is happening around you
sentence: She walked on, {oblivious} to the rain soaking her coat.
translation: Она шла дальше, не замечая дождя, промочившего её пальто.

definition: a poem that praises a person or thing
sentence: The poet wrote an {ode} to the autumn moon.
translation: Поэт написал оду осенней луне.

definition: done openly, so that everyone can see it
sentence: There was no {overt} hostility, but nobody spoke to him.
translation: Открытой враждебности не было, но никто с ним не разговаривал.

definition: the oldest and most respected man in a family or group
sentence: The family {patriarch} still runs the business at ninety.
translation: Глава семьи в девяносто лет по-прежнему управляет бизнесом.

definition: an expensive flat on the top floor of a tall building
sentence: The singer lives in a {penthouse} with a view of the whole city.
translation: Певица живёт в пентхаусе с видом на весь город.

definition: the crime of lying in court after promising to tell the truth
sentence: The witness was charged with {perjury} for changing her story.
translation: Свидетельницу обвинили в лжесвидетельстве за то, что она изменила показания.

definition: having strong religious beliefs and showing them in your behavior
sentence: The {pious} old woman went to church every morning.
translation: Набожная старушка ходила в церковь каждое утро.

definition: too early, before the expected or proper time
sentence: The baby was born {prematurely}, at thirty weeks.
translation: Ребёнок родился преждевременно, на тридцатой неделе.

definition: a new rise or increase of something after a period of decline
sentence: Vinyl records have enjoyed a {resurgence} in recent years.
translation: Виниловые пластинки переживают возрождение в последние годы.

definition: equipment with a tank of air that lets you breathe underwater
sentence: We went {scuba} diving on the coral reef.
translation: Мы ныряли с аквалангом на коралловом рифе.

definition: happening smoothly without any breaks or problems
sentence: The move to the new office was {seamless}; nobody lost a day of work.
translation: Переезд в новый офис прошёл гладко, никто не потерял ни дня работы.

definition: the line where the land meets the sea or a lake
sentence: We walked along the {shoreline} collecting shells.
translation: Мы шли вдоль береговой линии и собирали ракушки.

definition: to make someone feel disgusted or shocked, or to become ill
sentence: Pictures of the cruelty would {sicken} anyone.
translation: Картины этой жестокости вызвали бы отвращение у любого.

definition: too pleased with yourself in a way that annoys others
sentence: He gave a {smug} smile when his rival lost.
translation: Он самодовольно улыбнулся, когда его соперник проиграл.

definition: the study of the light that substances give off or absorb, used to identify them
sentence: Astronomers use {spectroscopy} to learn what stars are made of.
translation: Астрономы используют спектроскопию, чтобы узнать состав звёзд.

definition: not moving or changing, used of water, air or an economy
sentence: The pond was {stagnant} and smelled of rotting leaves.
translation: Пруд был стоячим и пах гниющими листьями.

definition: the quality of being strong and able to deal with difficulty
sentence: The marathon tests mental {toughness} as much as fitness.
translation: Марафон проверяет психологическую стойкость не меньше, чем физическую форму.

definition: not replied to or not solved
sentence: Her letters to the company went {unanswered} for months.
translation: Её письма в компанию месяцами оставались без ответа.

definition: not following accepted moral standards, especially in business
sentence: It is {unethical} for a doctor to accept gifts from drug companies.
translation: Для врача неэтично принимать подарки от фармацевтических компаний.

definition: relating to urine and the parts of the body that produce and remove it
sentence: A {urinary} infection kept her in bed for three days.
translation: Инфекция мочевых путей продержала её в постели три дня.

definition: very brave, especially in a difficult situation
sentence: The firefighters made a {valiant} effort to save the church.
translation: Пожарные предприняли отважную попытку спасти церковь.

definition: to become too hot, or to make something too hot
sentence: The engine will {overheat} if you drive uphill in this weather.
translation: Двигатель перегреется, если ехать в гору в такую погоду.

definition: a person who pays money to live in a house or use something
sentence: Every {renter} in the building got a letter about higher rent.
translation: Каждый арендатор в доме получил письмо о повышении платы.

definition: to cut branches off a tree or bush to help it grow better
sentence: You should {prune} the roses in early spring.
translation: Розы нужно обрезать ранней весной.
